vo: Wood stove label: still send CPSC one?
Say she's mailed copies for years. Since September twenty-first, twenty twenty-six, that section is gone.
Here's the catch. The notice on the stove itself still has to be there.
So she skips the mailing and checks her label: clearances, floor protection, chimney type.

caption:
Wood stove importers: one CPSC paperwork step ended on September 21, 2026.
16 CFR 1406.5, which had manufacturers and importers send CPSC copies of the stove notice and directions, was removed.
The consumer side stays: 16 CFR 1406.4 still requires a notice on the appliance with minimum clearances, floor protection and chimney type, plus directions.
Say a seller stops the mailing. The label on the stove still has to be right.
Not sure which rules apply? Comment M&Z and we'll DM you the free CPSC Finder.

sources.claim: Before: importers sent CPSC copies of the notice
sources.quote: Manufacturers, including importers, of coal and wood burning appliances as defined in § 1406.3(a) shall provide to the Commission the following performance and technical data related to performance and safety. (a) Written notice. Manufacturers shall provide to the Commission copies of the written notice required by § 1406.4(a).
identifier 1406.5, name '§ 1406.5 Performance and technical data to be furnished to the Commission.', amendment_date 2026-09-21, removed true (amendment published at 91 FR 46267, July 23, 2026)

sources.claim: Notice on the appliance (clearances, floor protection, chimney) + directions still required
sources.quote: (a) Written notice on appliance. (1) The appliance shall bear a legible notice containing the following performance and technical data. (i) Appropriate minimum clearances from unprotected combustibles to avoid the occurrence of fire. ... (ii) Type and dimensions of floor protection, if necessary to protect combustible floors. (iii) Proper type(s) of chimney and chimney connector to be used with the appliance. ... (b) Directions. sources.claim: Part 1406: importers of wood stoves give consumers a notification
sources.quote: This part requires manufacturers, including importers, of coal and wood burning appliances, as defined in § 1406.3(a), to provide consumers with a specified notification concerning the installation, operation, and maintenance of the appliances.
